app_store.name: Handspan: Piano Lessons
app_store.subtitle: Read, count and play for real
app_store.promotional_text: The whole first course is free, start to finish. Then one clear price, a reminder 2 days before any charge, and cancel in one tap.
app_store.description:
Handspan teaches you to play piano for real: to read the notes, keep time and play on your own. Put your iPhone or iPad on the music stand of any acoustic or digital piano and start.

RECOGNITION YOU CAN TRUST
Handspan tunes itself to your piano, hears the right octave, and never counts a wrong note, even inside a chord. With a USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard it reads the keys directly. If it ever marks a right note wrong, tap "I played that right".

FIX THE BAR, NOT THE SONG
A few mistakes never send you back to the top. Handspan loops just the bar that went wrong, at the tempo you choose, then puts it back into the piece.

TIMING, NOT ONLY NOTES
Every note gets a timing mark: early, on time or late. You see your rhythm, not just your accuracy.

THE WHY, IN 30 SECONDS
A short card before each new idea: rests, time signatures, key signatures. Real musical terms, explained once.

START WHERE YOU ARE
Take a 2-minute placement when you begin, or test out of any course by playing its final piece.

YOUR SOUND STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
Note detection runs on your iPhone or iPad. No recording of your playing is uploaded.

ALSO
- Songs in three levels, at any tempo, one hand at a time
- A metronome and finger numbers
- A weekly streak with freezes
- Up to 5 learners on one Household plan

PRICES, UP FRONT
The whole first course is free, start to finish, with no time limit.
Solo: $9.99 a month or $99.99 a year.
Household (up to 5 learners): $14.99 a month or $149.99 a year.
Monthly and yearly both come with a 7-day free trial. We send a reminder 2 days before any charge. Cancel any time in Settings › Subscription, or in your Apple account settings. Payment is charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

No ads, for anyone.

Privacy policy: https://handspan.vercel.app/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://handspan.vercel.app/terms.html
